profile.name: MSO-X 混合信号示波器
profile.description: 台式混合信号示波器，用于采集和显示电路中的模拟与数字时域信号。常用于电子实验中的波形观察、时序分析、信号完整性检查，以及电压、频率、脉宽等参数的自动测量与统计。
profile.description_en: A bench-top mixed signal oscilloscope used to acquire and display analog and digital time-domain signals in electronic circuits. It is commonly used in laboratories for waveform observation, timing analysis, signal integrity checks, and automatic measurement/statistics of parameters such as voltage, frequency, and pulse width.

registry.description: MSOX Series Mixed Signal Oscilloscope是由Keysight Technologies生产的表征设备，主要功能包括测量。支持Signal, Slot等操作。
